project.name: spiderweb-pr land/ocean analysis
project.claim: Spiderweb is the authoritative producer of hashed spatial-analysis-result/1.0 artifacts for land/ocean consumers

evidence.description: Spiderweb owns geometry; Skywatcher consumes results; TheHub owns control/provenance.
Python compilation, JSON parse, and git diff whitespace checks passed.
No source-native GEBCO raster bytes exist in either inspected Git snapshot, so raster identity remains unresolved.
Existing marine/io/terrain/contract/adjudication suite passed 85 assertions after the omitted Shapely dependency was supplied to the two affected tests.
Unified point, geodesic profile, exact topology and sensor footprint engine preserves source/datum/null semantics.
Every GitHub workflow on remote PR head 0d4635e failed before executing steps; step arrays and retrievable logs are absent.
A frozen source-native NOAA/NCEI San Juan 1/9 arc-second topobathymetric NetCDF was acquired and byte-bound to SHA-256 23aa9ae1b3df76265851fd423db963c261b1e26050f6bef9350f4e6544f31109.
Three non-synthetic C6062 observations sampled the frozen raster at -580.1058 m, -725.8854 m and -725.8854 m and emitted verified spatial-analysis-result/1.0 rows.
The real C6062 source has empty bearing and no sensor azimuth, elevation or field-of-view telemetry; a real sensor footprint cannot be computed without fabrication.
